You're using ezANOVA in a manner with which it was not designed to work. Can you back up and explain why you can't just supply the arguments directly? 

On Monday, 19 September 2016, Prabhagaran M <prabh...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi,

How can we set dynamic values to the  options in ezANOVA function. I have found the following option, but it has some issues (see below) 

eval(substitute(ezANOVA(data = ANT, dv = dpv, wid = widv, between = btwv, type=3),
              list(widv = 'subnum', dpv = 'rt', btwv = c('group'))))

Error in table(temp[, names(temp) == wid]) : 
attempt to set an attribute on NULL

Thanks
